scenes.description: The tracker view with the search box, kind/grade/phase filters and the trophy card grid, seeded with 13 earned trophies so the progress line reads 13 of 55.
scenes.title: Tracker — all 55 trophies

scenes.description: The roadmap view grouping trophies into story, strands, free-roam, cleanup and platinum phases, each with its own progress bar, seeded with the same 13 earned trophies.

scenes.description: The detail page for trophy 37, Catch Me If You Can, showing the full guide, when to attempt it, the hint, the missable warning and the sources.
scenes.title: Detail — trophy 37, the missable one

scenes.description: The tracker view with spoilers off and a fresh profile, so hidden trophies appear as Hidden trophy — the safe first look for a new player.
scenes.title: Spoiler-safe tracker
